g.text: Each cell: the number of Aequi, and three of them (fewest, median and most faces) when there are more than three; faces beside each die.

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1c1e22

g.text: Empty cell: no Aequus there. Vacuus kind (under each group): heart = centrally symmetric; inherited heart = parallel faces, no centre.

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1c1e22

g.text: k: k of the cell are non-heart (no two faces parallel; 5 dice in all).
